resolution.note: ship regenerates a generated-only rebase conflict (src/ci/rebase-generated.ts)

title: A rebase conflict only in generated files is regenerated by ship instead of stopping the lane
body:
Why: on 2026-11-14 at least four lane rebases (lane-drain #781, doctor-host #795, adopt-refresh #797, deploy-safe) hit a conflict in the generated docs/generated/capability-index.md; ship exits 76 and the lane regenerates by hand.
Outcome: a conflict confined to generated files never stops a lane: krn pr ship's rebase resolves docs/generated/capability-index.md (and any other file the generator owns) by regenerating it from the rebased src and continues; a conflict in any other file still exits 76.
Proof: ship test with a real temp repository where two branches change src headers (conflicting index only) rebases cleanly; npm run fast PASS.
